title: Ruinous
subtitle: Death, decay, withering
text: Ruinous tendency is rot, entropy, and the inevitable end. It thrives on decay and lingering harm. Blood aged in entropy has passed through so much death that death has become its natural language. It does not destroy quickly — it dissolves slowly, thoroughly, and completely. Ruinous-tended blood does not rush either. It simply outlasts in a different direction than Frigid does.
